ideas.pitch: An automated testing agent that parses APK binaries, exercises critical user journeys, identifies consistent UI/functional regressions, and generates evidence logs formatted directly for Mozark's performance platform.
ideas.problem_statement: Take a real app, test it, fix what breaks, and prove it performs on Mozark's platform, on real devices.
ideas.title: MozarkAPKTestAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with Mozark's core scoring criteria of finding consistent user journey breaks and providing rigorous evidence for a 100-point scale leaderboard.

ideas.pitch: A telemetry-injection toolkit that hooks into Android APKs to isolate hidden performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, and render drops during heavy user flows, mapping them to concrete evidence scores.
ideas.problem_statement: Take a real app, test it, fix what breaks, and prove it performs on Mozark's platform, on real devices.
ideas.title: AeroAPK Trace & Fix
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins by bypassing surface-level UI bugs and hunting for the hard technical performance failures that earn the separate 50-point bonus.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight diagnostic harness designed to simulate concurrent device runs against custom APKs to filter out minor style quirks and isolate high-severity journey breakers that fail at least 2 out of 3 runs.
ideas.problem_statement: Take a real app, test it, fix what breaks, and prove it performs on Mozark's platform, on real devices.
ideas.title: JourneySentry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Optimizes strictly for the hackathon's exact scoring metric where bugs must break a key user journey and fail consistently across multiple test runs.

ideas.pitch: A local emulation runner that intercepts APK network and UI payloads to automatically patch common crash vectors and verify that performance metrics meet real-device threshold requirements.
ideas.problem_statement: Take a real app, test it, fix what breaks, and prove it performs on Mozark's platform, on real devices.
ideas.title: PerfValidator Core
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact verification pain point highlighted by judges: proving an AI-generated or raw app actually works under real-world conditions rather than just looking good.

ideas.pitch: An evidence collection script and dashboard that systematically logs error traces, execution run counts, and device stability states to maximize points across the fixed 100-point evaluation scale.
ideas.problem_statement: Take a real app, test it, fix what breaks, and prove it performs on Mozark's platform, on real devices.
ideas.title: APK-Health-Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins by treating evaluation as a strict data game, ensuring every submitted bug report is backed by indisputable run evidence rather than subjective judgment.
